meaning.en: A baby babbling and starting to learn to speak.
meaning.zh: 婴儿咿咿呀呀地学说话。

examples.zh: 女儿刚开始牙牙学语，家里充满欢笑。
examples.en: Our daughter has just started babbling her first words and the house is full of laughter.

examples.zh: 牙牙学语的孩子最爱模仿大人。
examples.en: Toddlers learning to talk love to copy adults.

meaning.en: Without any boundary; extremely vast.
meaning.zh: 没有边界，形容极其广阔。

equivalents: stretching as far as the eye can see

examples.zh: 无边无际的大海在眼前展开。
examples.en: The boundless sea stretched out before us.

examples.zh: 她陷入了无边无际的悲伤。
examples.en: She sank into a boundless sorrow.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; physical or abstract.
usage.zh: 作定语、谓语，可指实物或抽象事物。

meaning.en: To put public interest first and forget one's own.
meaning.zh: 一心为公，不考虑个人利益。

equivalents: put the public good before oneself

examples.zh: 他一生公而忘私，深受群众爱戴。
examples.en: He lived selflessly for the public good and was loved by the people.

examples.zh: 老局长公而忘私的作风值得学习。
examples.en: The old director's selfless dedication is worth learning from.

story.en: Jia Yi: 'Put the state before the family, the public before the private' (国而忘家，公而忘私).
story.zh: 《汉书》：“故化成俗定，则为人臣者，主而忘身，国而忘家，公而忘私。”

usage.zh: 作谓语、定语，多用于赞扬。

meaning.en: After a long time; over the long run.
meaning.zh: 时间长了，经过很长的时间。

examples.zh: 天长日久，两人成了无话不谈的朋友。
examples.en: Over time the two became friends who could talk about anything.

examples.zh: 习惯这东西，天长日久就养成了。
examples.en: Habits form with time.

usage.en: Adverbial, usually at the start of a clause.

meaning.en: Someone who lives without purpose or spirit, as good as dead.
meaning.zh: 只会走动的尸体，比喻不动脑筋、庸碌无为的人。

examples.zh: 失去目标后，他活得像行尸走肉。
examples.en: Having lost his goals, he lived like a zombie.

examples.zh: 不要做只知享乐的行尸走肉。
examples.en: Don't be an empty shell that only chases pleasure.

meaning.en: To be overly picky when choosing.
meaning.zh: 挑来挑去，嫌这嫌那。

examples.zh: 找工作别挑三拣四，先干起来再说。
examples.en: Don't be so choosy about jobs; get started first.

examples.zh: 这孩子吃饭总是挑三拣四。
examples.en: The child is always fussy about food.

pinyin: jūn zǐ zhī jiāo dàn rú shuǐ
natural: a gentleman's friendship is plain as water

meaning.en: True friendship does not depend on flattery or favours.
meaning.zh: 君子之间的交情不靠甜言蜜语和物质往来，平淡而真诚。

examples.zh: 君子之交淡如水，我们不常联系，但彼此都放心。
examples.en: Our friendship is plain as water: we rarely meet, but trust each other.

examples.zh: 他们君子之交淡如水，却相知多年。
examples.en: Theirs is an undemonstrative friendship, yet they have known each other for years.

story.en: Zhuangzi: 'The friendship of the gentleman is plain as water; that of the petty man is sweet as wine' (君子之交淡若水，小人之交甘若醴).
story.zh: 《庄子》：“君子之交淡若水，小人之交甘若醴。”

date.zh: 战国中期 · 前4—前3世纪

usage.en: Complete saying, often followed by 小人之交甘如醴.
usage.zh: 完整的名言，常与“小人之交甘如醴”对举。

meaning.en: To speak with passion and conviction.
meaning.zh: 情绪激昂地陈述自己的意见。

examples.zh: 他在会上慷慨陈词，赢得了掌声。
examples.en: He spoke passionately at the meeting and won applause.

examples.zh: 律师慷慨陈词，为当事人辩护。
examples.en: The lawyer made an impassioned plea for his client.

meaning.en: To confine oneself within self-set limits, or to limit others to a narrow circle.
meaning.zh: 在地上画个圈当作牢狱，比喻只许在限定范围内活动，或自我设限。

examples.zh: 不要画地为牢，要敢于走出舒适区。
examples.en: Don't box yourself in; dare to leave your comfort zone.

examples.zh: 他把自己画地为牢，几年没出过门。
examples.en: He confined himself so tightly that he hardly left home for years.

meaning.en: Without any gap or weakness to take advantage of.
meaning.zh: 没有空子可钻，没有机会可利用。

examples.zh: 防守滴水不漏，对手无机可乘。
examples.en: The defence was watertight and the opponents found no gap.

examples.zh: 管理制度严密，骗子无机可乘。
examples.en: With strict controls in place, fraudsters have no way in.

usage.en: Predicate; the opposite of 有机可乘.
usage.zh: 作谓语，与“有机可乘”相反。

meaning.en: Absurd and far from reason or reality.
meaning.zh: 荒唐离奇，不合常理。

examples.zh: 这种荒诞不经的说法，根本没人相信。
examples.en: Nobody believes such a preposterous claim.

examples.zh: 他编了个荒诞不经的借口。
examples.en: He made up an absurd excuse.

meaning.en: A family with many members, thriving.
meaning.zh: 家族成员众多，兴盛发达。

examples.zh: 祝你们家人丁兴旺，万事如意。
examples.en: May your family prosper and grow.

examples.zh: 这个村子人丁兴旺，一家几代同堂。
examples.en: The village is full of large families living together across generations.

meaning.en: It is too late for regret.
meaning.zh: 后悔也来不及了。

equivalents: it's too late to be sorry

examples.zh: 等到失去了才珍惜，悔之晚矣。
examples.en: Cherishing it only after losing it is too late.

examples.zh: 现在不努力，将来悔之晚矣。
examples.en: If you don't work hard now, you'll regret it when it's too late.

meaning.en: A brilliant touch in writing or art that seems inspired.
meaning.zh: 形容诗文、书画中突然出现的绝妙之笔，仿佛有神助。

examples.zh: 结尾那句对白堪称神来之笔。
examples.en: That last line of dialogue is a true stroke of genius.

examples.zh: 这一笔真是神来之笔，画面顿时活了。
examples.en: That one stroke was inspired and brought the picture to life.

meaning.en: Born at a bad time, so unable to make use of one's talents.
meaning.zh: 生在不好的时代，才能无处施展。

examples.zh: 他才华出众，却生不逢时。
examples.en: He was brilliantly talented but born at the wrong time.

examples.zh: 别感叹生不逢时，要在现实中寻找机会。
examples.en: Don't lament your timing; look for chances in the world as it is.

meaning.en: Flowers of every kind blooming in rivalry.
meaning.zh: 各种花朵竞相开放，比喻事物繁荣兴盛。

examples.zh: 春天的公园里百花争艳。
examples.en: In spring the park is a riot of blossom.

examples.zh: 今年的电影市场百花争艳。
examples.en: This year's film market is flourishing with variety.

usage.zh: 作谓语，可指实景，也可作比喻。

natural: can be counted on one hand

meaning.en: So few that they can be counted easily.
meaning.zh: 数量很少，一数就数得清。

equivalents: can be counted on one hand

examples.zh: 能坚持到最后的人寥寥可数。
examples.en: Those who persevere to the end are a mere handful.

examples.zh: 会这门手艺的人如今寥寥可数。
examples.en: Few people can still do this craft.

meaning.en: To speak up for the people and seek relief for them.
meaning.zh: 替百姓向当权者请求解除苦难。

examples.zh: 这位清官为民请命，不惜得罪权贵。
examples.en: The honest official championed the people, even at the risk of offending the powerful.

examples.zh: 她当了律师，立志为民请命。
examples.en: She became a lawyer, determined to speak up for ordinary people.

meaning.en: To be attacked from both front and back.
meaning.zh: 前后都受到敌人攻击，形容处境艰难。

examples.zh: 我军腹背受敌，处境十分危险。
examples.en: Our army was attacked from both sides and in grave danger.

examples.zh: 公司腹背受敌，既要应对对手，又要面对监管。
examples.en: The firm is squeezed from both sides, facing rivals and regulators alike.

meaning.en: Forgetful and careless, always leaving things behind.
meaning.zh: 形容做事马虎或记性不好，常忘这忘那。

examples.zh: 他总是丢三落四，出门常忘带钥匙。
examples.en: He's so forgetful that he often leaves without his keys.

examples.zh: 你这丢三落四的毛病得改改。
examples.en: You must cure yourself of this absent-mindedness.

usage.en: Predicate; note 落 is read là.

natural: a young lady of good family

meaning.en: A well-bred young woman from a distinguished family.
meaning.zh: 旧时指出身名门、教养良好的年轻女子。

equivalents: a girl from a good family

examples.zh: 她举止优雅，颇有大家闺秀的风范。
examples.en: Her graceful manner has the air of a well-born young lady.

examples.zh: 小说里的林黛玉是典型的大家闺秀。
examples.en: Lin Daiyu in the novel is a typical well-bred young lady.

usage.en: Noun phrase; often with 风范/气质.
usage.zh: 名词性短语，常与“风范、气质”搭配。

meaning.en: To resound through the sky; extremely loud.
meaning.zh: 声音大得直冲云天。

examples.zh: 球进了，欢呼声响彻云霄。
examples.en: The goal went in and the cheers rang to the skies.

examples.zh: 嘹亮的歌声响彻云霄。
examples.en: Clear singing echoed to the heavens.
